environment.description: Go Gin application deployed on a bare EC2 instance (Amazon Linux 2023, t3.medium) in a public subnet with a public IP. Security group allows inbound TCP/8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No load balancer, no WAF, no network ACL restrictions beyond default. Application runs as root user. Instance is in a VPC with an Internet Gateway and default route table pointing 0.0.0.0/0 to the IGW.
